rationales: A supercritical fluid exists above its critical temperature and pressure, not ordinarily in neon signs.
Neon signs contain ionized neon gas, which is plasma.
Neon is a gas before it is ionized, but the glowing matter in an operating sign is plasma.
Liquid crystals have properties intermediate between liquids and crystalline solids and are not the matter in neon signs.
Geochemistry studies the chemical composition and processes of Earth materials, not the environmental effects of shopping bags.
Inorganic chemistry focuses on compounds generally outside organic chemistry, rather than the environmental hazards of bags.
Analytical chemistry is concerned with identifying and measuring substances, not primarily with their environmental effects.
Environmental chemistry studies the effects of pollutants and waste, including hazards associated with shopping bags.
Starch is a naturally occurring polymer made by plants.
Polystyrene is a synthetic, man-made polymer.
Proteins are naturally occurring polymers made from amino acids.
Cellulose is a naturally occurring polymer found in plant cell walls.
Brass is an alloy and does not form the characteristic rhombic crystals asked about here.
Sulphur can form rhombic crystals, known as rhombic sulphur.
Graphite crystallizes in a layered hexagonal structure rather than a rhombic one.
Bronze is an alloy and is not the substance with rhombic crystals.
Milk is a colloid in which fat droplets are dispersed through water.
Slaked lime used for whitewash is a suspension of solid particles in water.
Vinegar is acetic acid dissolved in water, forming a true solution.
Silver chloride is insoluble in water and forms a suspension or precipitate rather than a colloidal solution.
Calcium hydroxide dissolved in water forms a solution that is homogeneous in the dissolved portion.
Potassium nitrate dissolved in water forms a homogeneous solution.
Hot chocolate may contain dispersed particles, but concrete is the clearly heterogeneous mixture among these choices.
Concrete is heterogeneous because its components, such as cement, sand, and aggregate, remain distinct and unevenly distributed.
Liquid crystals have properties intermediate between those of ordinary liquids and crystalline solids.
A supercritical fluid is a substance above its critical temperature and pressure, not the state defined here.
Plasma is an ionized gas and does not have the stated intermediate properties.
Dark matter is a proposed form of matter in astrophysics, not this state of matter.
A true solution has particles too small to be visible and does not show visible dispersed particles.
Colloid particles are small and generally cannot be seen individually with the naked eye.
A suspension contains dispersed particles large enough to be visible.
A saturated solution is defined by containing the maximum dissolved solute at a given condition, not by visible dispersed particles.
For potassium chlorate, lowering the temperature generally lowers its solubility in water.
The solubility of potassium chlorate decreases as the temperature is lowered.
Its solubility does not remain constant when temperature changes.
The solubility does not first increase and then decrease as temperature is lowered over the conditions described.
Organic chemistry studies carbon compounds, but the focus here is the rate of a process under changing conditions.
Analytical chemistry concerns determining the composition or amount of substances, not primarily reaction rates.
Biochemistry studies chemical processes in living organisms, whereas this question focuses on reaction kinetics under different temperatures.
Physical chemistry includes chemical kinetics and the study of how temperature affects reaction rates.
